title: Settlement & Custody
description: Institutional custody and settlement services, supported by technology that brings greater visibility to positions, balances and transactions.

overview.title: Nothing left in the dark.
overview.lead: The trade is only one part of the transaction.
overview.body: Cash movements, securities positions and outstanding trades all need to be accounted for. Our post-trade infrastructure connects settlement activity with account information, providing a clearer picture of what has happened and what remains outstanding.
overview.dashboardBody: The EMFI Dashboard brings together key account information:

custody.title: Custody is a responsibility not a feature.
custody.lead: Holding client money and securities comes with specific obligations.
custody.body: Our UK custody and safeguarding arrangements operate within the FCA's Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

rules.title: Client Money
paragraphs: Client money held or controlled by EMFI Capital Limited is subject to applicable segregation requirements. These include appropriate records, reconciliations and arrangements with the banks holding client money.
The statutory trust framework is designed to protect client money in the event of a firm's failure.

rules.title: Safe Custody Assets
paragraphs: Safe custody assets are subject to separate requirements governing their safekeeping, records and reconciliations.
These rules are designed to protect clients' ownership rights and help distinguish client assets from those belonging to the firm or other clients.

custody.callout: Segregation, accurate records, reconciliations and oversight are fundamental to the way custody arrangements operate.

entities.name: EMFI Capital Limited
entities.body: is authorised and regulated by the FCA and is subject to the applicable CASS requirements in respect of client money and safe custody assets it holds or controls.

entities.name: EMFI Capital (DIFC) Limited
entities.body: is separately regulated by the DFSA and subject to the applicable DIFC client asset requirements.

disclosures.notice: Client asset protections do not eliminate all custody, banking or third-party risks and do not protect against investment losses.
